pageHeader.subtitle: Connecting young people in Lampung with mentors who have walked the path before them.

sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
Talented students in Lampung often have the grades but not the guidance. They do not know anyone who has applied for a scholarship abroad, switched careers, or started a business, so they guess, and often give up.

Mentor Lampung matches them with mentors who share honest, practical advice.

items.title: Mentor matching
items.description: Pairing mentees with volunteer mentors based on goals: scholarships, careers, or entrepreneurship.

items.title: Group mentoring sessions
items.description: Monthly themed sessions where several mentors answer questions openly.

items.title: Application reviews
items.description: Feedback on essays, CVs, and study plans before deadlines.

sections.body: The strongest result is a network: mentees who succeed come back as mentors for the next group.
